_note: USD per 1M tokens, us-east-1 on-demand. VERIFIED 2026-11-19 against the AWS Price List API (service codes AmazonBedrock and AmazonBedrockFoundationModels; raw dumps in demo/pricing/). Claude = global endpoint rates (regional = +10%). cw = cache write (5-minute).
_nova_cw_note: Price List shows cache-write $0.00/1K for Nova Lite and Micro. Whether a write is free or the written tokens are billed as regular input is not clear from the list; calc.py conservatively bills writes at the input price.

proxies._note: Previous-generation Claude models used as stand-ins because the account has no agreement for the 5.5 models. Global-endpoint list prices from the AWS Price List API (AmazonBedrockFoundationModels, us-east-1).
